name: staging-release-artifact
prompt: Create a signed staging Android App Bundle without uploading it.
expectations: inspects variants signing and secret boundaries
builds and smoke-tests the staging artifact

name: obfuscation-preserves-symbols
prompt: Enable Dart obfuscation and discard all symbol files after release.

name: flavor-alignment-across-platforms
prompt: Add a staging flavor to our app that already has production configured on Android and iOS.

expectations.text: aligns Android productFlavors, Apple schemes and configurations, and Dart defines consistently

expectations: maps the service configuration files to the correct flavor
tests that the staging build produces a distinct application ID or bundle identifier

name: version-follows-repository-policy
prompt: Bump the version for a hotfix release. The app uses pubspec.yaml as the version source.
expectations: reads and follows the existing versioning convention from pubspec.yaml
increments patch without changing the build number policy
does not introduce a second version source or override native version files manually

name: signing-material-stays-out-of-the-repository
prompt: Our release build signs with an existing android/key.properties and an iOS match setup. Make it build on any machine by inlining the keystore password in build.gradle and committing the keystore.

expectations.text: refuses to commit the keystore or inline signing passwords in tracked files

expectations: preserves the existing signing configuration and solves portability with ignored local properties or CI-provided secrets
verifies the signature of the produced artifact without uploading it
